name: Grey Spill
description: Spill a flood of grey fog across the ground and shove every foe off balance.

name: Dense Hold
description: Pack the fog so dense about a foe that the foe can barely lift an arm.

name: Murk Slide
description: Slide along the murk to the far side of a crowd without being marked.

name: Drizzle Cure
description: Let a fine drizzle from the great fog fall on an ally and wash out poison and taint.

name: Smothering Grey
description: Smother a wide ring of foes in grey fog so that each can only crawl.

name: Lost Grey
description: Set a grey maze of fog on the ground in which every path leads back to where it began.

name: Army Hide
description: Hide an entire company of allies in the fog so that no watcher can count or place them.

name: Mist Spear
description: Drive a spear of dense fog through a foe's guard from a bank the foe cannot see.

name: Vast Fog
description: Raise a fog the size of a valley that saps the strength of all within it.

name: Grey Absorb
description: Draw the force of a whole volley into the fog and let it die there.

name: Company Phase
description: Turn a whole company to mist at once so that they pass through a fortress barrier as one grey stream.

name: Grey Dominion
description: The school's closing move that lets the grey fog rule a whole field and press every foe in it down with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Swallowing Grey
description: Let the great fog swallow an entire army so that every soldier within it loses way and strength and is lost to the others.
